title: The four chariots between the bronze mountains (eighth night vision)

symbols.in_text_interpretation: "The four winds (spirits) of the sky, which go out from standing before the Lord of all the earth" (6:5).
They "have quieted my spirit in the north country" (6:8).

description: Four chariots with red, black, white and dappled horses come out between two bronze mountains and go to the four winds; those going north have set the LORD's Spirit at rest in the north country.
